https://comix.to/title/e05zm-i-became-th.title: I Became The Villain The Hero Is Obsessed With
https://comix.to/title/e05zm-i-became-th.description:
Da-in, ended up possessing the villain of a story.

To make Stardust — the story's protagonist and his favorite character in a dystopian manga — happy, he resolves to become the villain Egoistic for her growth.

Da-in deliberately causes terror to enhance Stardust's abilities and preemptively prevents all the tragic events from the original story, but in the process, he gains public support while also drawing Stardust's suspicion.

Stardust, who initially opposed him, gradually opens her heart, and soon even begins to show signs of obsession towards him...?

https://comix.to/title/z0l20-god-level-a.title: God-level Assassin, I'm the Shadow
https://comix.to/title/z0l20-god-level-a.description:
In a world where people sleep and enter the realm abandoned by God, Qin Feng, who had sacrificed everything for his sister, is betrayed by her.
However, fate grants him a second chance, sending him back nine years before the abandoned world appears.
This time, Qin Feng chooses to abandon his sister and focus on becoming the strongest.

(Source: MangaUpdates)

https://comix.to/title/d6v8-youngest-sis.title: Youngest Sister-in-Law in a Tragic Reverse Harem
https://comix.to/title/d6v8-youngest-sis.description: One feverish night, 6-year-old Liliana Bercchio suddenly recalls the plot of a tragic reverse harem novel. Unsure if she's been reincarnated or has time traveled, her young mind struggles to make sense of it all. Her family is doomed to get caught up in the protagonists' mess—but there's still time… or so she thought. When she witnesses the female lead's death and the deranged male leads appear before her sisters, the story takes a turn. They seem different now, but is her family truly safe?

https://comix.to/title/kl6lv-101st-confe.title: 101st Confession
https://comix.to/title/kl6lv-101st-confe.description:
Lucia Agnes has confessed to her longtime crush 98 times over the past 13 years.

And Herwin Peneus has always turned her down.

After her 99th confession is also rejected, Lucia finally decides to give up on Herwin and agrees to meet a suitor chosen by her parents.

But just as she makes up her mind to get engaged to this new match, things start to take an unexpected turn...

https://comix.to/title/mnkmd-return-of-t.title: Return of the First Generation: The Strongest in History Reincarnates as His Descendant 1000 Years Later
https://comix.to/title/mnkmd-return-of-t.description:
Gilphas Eldragon, the founding patriarch of the Eldragon family, dedicated his entire life to the pursuit of absolute strength. In search of eternal combat, he consumed a legendary fruit rumored to grant immortality under the protection of the divine dragon. Yet the rumor was false—Gilphas aged, and in the end, passed away in his son’s arms. Or so it seemed. When he next opened his eyes, Gilphas found himself reborn a thousand years later as Zeke Eldragon, heir to his own bloodline. But the world had changed: the Eldragon clan now thrived under a ruthless creed of survival of the fittest, and a new threat known as the “Chaos” loomed over humanity. Faced with an unfamiliar era and even greater enemies, the ancient warrior feels only exhilaration. For Gilphas—now Zeke—this is the chance he longed for: “This time, I will witness the true end of martial strength!”

[Original Webtoon](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/192640)

https://comix.to/title/n8we-dungeons-and.title: Dungeons and Crayons
https://comix.to/title/n8we-dungeons-and.description: At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

https://comix.to/title/793e-arelyn-is-si.title: Arelyn Is Sick and Tired
https://comix.to/title/793e-arelyn-is-si.description: The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

https://comix.to/title/q9wkd-may-i-cry-n.title: May I Cry Now?
https://comix.to/title/q9wkd-may-i-cry-n.description:
After killing his brother, Clois ascends to the throne. His desire to become emperor was not for personal gain but for the sake of his beloved wife and soon-to-be-born child. However, upon his return, the corpses of his wife and child greeted him, demonstrating the futility of his efforts.

Seven years later, he couldn’t find joy in anything in the world. So, he didn’t care about the re-opening of the gifted academy’s admissions after seven years. Until he saw a wrinkled application form rolling on the floor. Instead of trying to enroll the child in the gifted academy, he offered various excuses. The document, thrown away like trash without even being considered due to being from a workhouse.

“I approve this child’s admission.”

He wasn’t particularly interested. It was just a warning to those who tried to act arbitrarily. So he couldn’t even remember the name of the child he picked.

“My name is Ivy Alden.”

The child he met in front of his wife’s and daughter’s graves resembled the daughter he had always imagined.

https://comix.to/title/gm793-asha-of-the.title: Asha of the Border
https://comix.to/title/gm793-asha-of-the.description:
Branded a cursed princess fated to kill the king, Princess Renée is cast out of the palace after her father's death. Rescued by Eden of the border clans, she grows up in exile and learns love for the first time—until the truth drags her back.

**Official Translations:**    
[English](https://manta.net/en/series/asha-of-the-borderlands?seriesId=5534)

https://comix.to/title/l7re-you-think-it.title: You Think It's Easy Rewriting A Story?
https://comix.to/title/l7re-you-think-it.description:
Reincarnation stories are all the rage these days, but I never thought I’d be the one getting reborn! But still, life as a rich man’s beautiful daughter is pretty sweet... except for one thing. No matter what I do, where I run, or who I romance, this novel is dead-set on getting me hitched to the handsome duke destined to kill me! 

There must be some way to change my fate, right? I won't go out like this!

https://comix.to/title/02x1q-i-became-th.title: I Became the Stepmother of a Terminally Ill Child
https://comix.to/title/02x1q-i-became-th.description:
"You're telling me to save a baby with only a short time left to live?" 
After the death of her parents, Countess Clarisse lost everything to her uncle's family. To claim the only inheritance her parents left behind, she must recover the family heirloom, the magic stone, that was sold off. The one who now possesses that stone is none other than the ruthless Duke Albert, rumored to "use even children as tools of war"! But now, that very ruthless Duke is raising a baby with a rattle in his hand instead of a sword! Unaware of this, Clarisse visits the Duke's estate to strike a deal, only to encounter the dying infant, Theodore, and discover that she alone has the power to save him. Seeing her worth, the Duke offers her a deal: to become Theo's mother figure and in exchange, he will return the heirloom. But despite thinking she no longer needed a family, Clarisse slowly finds everyone around her starting to become obsessed with keeping her!

[Original Webtoon](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/187664)

https://comix.to/title/ewer8-my-contract.title: My Contractually Married Husband Wants Me
https://comix.to/title/ewer8-my-contract.description:
Princess Alexa Calenda knows she is nothing more than a quiet spoil of war to her husband. To her, Grand Duke Eric Lansmore is merely a cold stranger, and their forced political union is defined by a desolate silence. But a dangerous aphrodisiac shatters that distance, forcing them into each other’s arms for a night of unbridled desire. While Alexa fully expects a return to their distant routine, she finds herself completely overwhelmed by Eric’s terrifyingly intense affection. Her indifferent companion is now replaced by a desperately needy lover.

(Source: Tappytoon)

https://comix.to/title/mr3m0-the-forgott.title: The Forgotten Field
https://comix.to/title/mr3m0-the-forgott.description:
I pray every dayfor this love to die.
That I may love you only until today,
and by tomorrow, may this love be dead.

-Born of an affair, the ill-fated imperial princess Thalia Roem Guirta.

She grows up twisted beneath the neglect of indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings,
and servants who look upon her with contempt.
To survive, Thalia learns to protect herself by baring her thorns at everyone who comes near.
And yet, even she becomes utterly defenseless before one man.

That man is Varkas Raedgo Seorkan, the noble young lord of the East.

A vassal of the imperial family and heir to a grand duke,
he was raised under relentless pressure to be perfect.
Shaped by discipline so harsh it bordered on abuse,
he grew up with most of his emotions long since numbed.
A man who exists solely for his family’s honor and duty.

To keep a promise made to the late empress,
he becomes engaged to Ayla, Thalia’s half-sister.

And Thalia, consumed by despair, begins to slowly break apart.

But then—

the love fated to end in her death reaches an unexpected turning point….

https://comix.to/title/8v88-martial-evol.title: Martial Evolution: Start by Awakening the King of Monsters
https://comix.to/title/8v88-martial-evol.description: A youth named Yi He is reborn into the world of powerful Martial arts and awakens the King of Monsters with the strongest bloodline!

https://comix.to/title/qqwrm-full-time-a.title: Full-Time Awakening
https://comix.to/title/qqwrm-full-time-a.description:
As the captain of the Divine Legion and the strongest Awakener, Bai Yi is betrayed by a comrade, witnessing all his teammates die before his eyes. Only then does he realize he has always been a pawn of those in power. Having lost everything, he is reborn 20 years ago, back to his middle school days before awakening.

At that time, his family and teammates are still alive. To save them, to avenge the betrayer, and to overthrow the entire corrupt ruling system, he embarks on a lonely path of strength.

[Original Webtoon](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/656553)

**Official Translations:**

https://comix.to/title/w0wj9-not-your-mo.title: Not Your Monster-In-Law
https://comix.to/title/w0wj9-not-your-mo.description: After her husband's sudden death, she became a widow and the head of a noble family. Her stepson, cheerful and supportive, takes her side, while her older daughter-in-law, who dislikes her, warns, "Please maintain proper decorum." Amidst this brewing mother-in-law vs. daughter-in-law drama, she uses her past life experience as a tutor to open a counseling service for troubled souls. A modern-day noble family conflict with a twist: free counseling sessions! (No appearance fees.)

https://comix.to/title/nk9re-patron-of-v.title: Patron of Villains
https://comix.to/title/nk9re-patron-of-v.description:
One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

https://comix.to/title/lgkg7-fog-land.title: Fog Land
https://comix.to/title/lgkg7-fog-land.description: Fogland, a mysterious international prison, traps Dante Kang a science teacher sent to reform prisoners during a sudden riot, leaving him with only one way to escape: by becoming a leader.

https://comix.to/title/e1wlg-the-scandal.title: The Scandal Maker Has Returned
https://comix.to/title/e1wlg-the-scandal.description:
"You know it, Uncle—that I'm not the 'Scandal Maker.'"

Framed for her cousin Bella's crimes, labeled a "Scandal Maker" and branded a "thief" who coveted a duke's belongings—all that was left for Harriet Listerwell was a ruined name and a life stained by false infamy. But the moment she discovers that behind every one of those tragedies was Bella's chilling smile, she makes a decision:

She will become the real Scandal Maker.

https://comix.to/title/6dk28-the-glutton.title: The Glutton: Devourer of Kings
https://comix.to/title/6dk28-the-glutton.description:
The human world was destroyed by the demon lords. Having lost everything, the awakened warrior Si Chen chooses to launch a desperate, final attack… sacrificing himself in order to take down the demon lord of gluttony, Lan Yue. But when he wakes up again, he finds himself transported ten years into the past, before any of this happened. Realizing that his powers have awakened earlier, he decides he must act early. With his return, everything else in the world seems to have changed as well…

[Original Webtoon](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc39692)

https://comix.to/title/zdm9j-do-your-bes.title: Do Your Best and Regret
https://comix.to/title/zdm9j-do-your-bes.description:
A woman who spent fourteen years loving those who never saw her worth finally walks away, choosing the one person who chose her first, a decorated duke. 

But as she embraces this new life, the very people who ignored her now desperately cling to her shadow.

https://comix.to/title/q9gjd-bunker-days.title: Bunker Days
https://comix.to/title/q9gjd-bunker-days.description:
As a child, Seo-woo rejected Won-hyeok, the boy who once led her into the darkness of a bunker. Years later, now a high school student living a life of bitter isolation, Seo-woo finds herself driven to the edge. In the middle of an attempt to end it all, she stumbles upon another abandoned bunker and steps inside to hide. But her sanctuary becomes a prison when she is trapped inside by none other than Won-hyeok—who returns drenched in fresh blood.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=846643), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13621636)

https://comix.to/title/3rdr3-i-became-th.title: I Became The Rogue First Prince
https://comix.to/title/3rdr3-i-became-th.description:
Reborn as a sword, I lived for several hundred years, spending my entire existence looking after everyone.

Then, out of nowhere, I took over the body of a fifteen-year-old uncouth first prince.

"**Do you have any idea how many I've raised?**"

The great knight once called the **Undefeated**, the **Dragon Slayer** who brought down the **Mad Dragon**, the ***Mercenary King***, and more... I raised every single one of them.

The ***Magic Sword Gruhorn*** possessed the body of the uncouth first prince...And has begun to write a new legend.

---

**Original Webtoon:**     
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/68486653), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%A7%9D%EB%82%98%EB%8B%88-1%EC%99%95%EC%9E%90%EA%B0%80-%EB%90%98%EC%97%88%EB%8B%A4/4758)

https://comix.to/title/lw2j-the-black-le.title: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby
https://comix.to/title/lw2j-the-black-le.description: The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

https://comix.to/title/rrzm-the-regresse.title: The Regressed Genius Player's Mythical-Rank Weapon Creation
https://comix.to/title/rrzm-the-regresse.description:
With the death of Earth’s potential Constellation, the Crimson Eye is now bent on consuming the world. 

Simun Kim--an alchemist out of necessity, due to an inability to use magic--successfully transmuted the Philosopher’s Stone to stop this cosmic threat. But he still failed. As death closes in, the Philosopher’s Stone rewinds time, waking Simun in the past with one last chance to rewrite the end of the world.

https://comix.to/title/ll1w2-i-will-prot.title: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!
https://comix.to/title/ll1w2-i-will-prot.description:
Reborn as a small-town child in a fantasy novel, Sien discovers her father is the exiled heir of a villainous duchy. Fearing their return to the ruthless family, she strives to protect him.  

But wait—her dad was once a tyrant?  

A heartwarming tale of a secretly powerful dad and his scheming daughter trying to preserve his innocence unfolds in this delightful mix of humor and healing misunderstandings.

https://comix.to/title/9wlr-dianas-deare.title: Diana's Dearest Is the Family's Favorite
https://comix.to/title/9wlr-dianas-deare.description: After traveling back in time, Lia finds herself in the orphanage where she spent her childhood just before Diana, the lost daughter of Duke Ellad, arrives. Remembering with regret how she once ignored Diana's mistreatment in the orphanage, she vows to protect her until her family finds her. The two grow close, and she sees her life unfolding in an unexpected way as she is welcomed into House Ellad with Diana. Will Lia find happiness in her second life, surrounded by love she's never known?

https://comix.to/title/l2r27-once-an-ass.title: Once an Assassin, Now a Royal Nanny
https://comix.to/title/l2r27-once-an-ass.description:
A year after her lover stabs her in the back, legendary assassin Kyla Angel wakes up in the body of Rachel Brown, a nanny tasked with caring for a neglected prince and princess. Knowing the man who betrayed her is still out there, Kyla must bide her time before she can sneak out of the palace and get revenge. But in the meantime, she must face her deadliest challenge yet: childcare. Now it's up to Kyla to figure out how to soothe a crying toddler with hands meant for throwing daggers and slitting throats...(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.

https://comix.to/title/rd7d1-infinite-ev.title: Infinite Evolution Starting from Zero
https://comix.to/title/rd7d1-infinite-ev.description: Exhausting all waste and decline, breaking the limits. Innate talent of a celestial being, a top scholar at the peak. Multiple forms, transcending evolution. Reborn, starting from zero, infinite evolution.

https://comix.to/title/vw9zy-i-faked-a-p.title: I Faked a Pregnancy, but My Husband Returned
https://comix.to/title/vw9zy-i-faked-a-p.description:
Judith wakes up one day to find herself a debt-ridden baroness overnight following her father’s death - and then realizes she has reincarnated inside a novel she once read in her past life. Deciding to use her knowledge of the original plot to pay off her debts, she enters the duke’s household as a contract daughter-in-law, posing as the fake wife of the family’s missing son. Pay off the debts, enjoy the luxuries she could never afford in her real life - it’s only for a few months, so why not make the most of it? But then, the husband who, in the original novel, never comes back, comes back.

“So you are my wife. The one carrying my child."
« Alors vous êtes ma femme. Celle qui porte mon enfant. »

https://comix.to/title/xqg6j-high-martia.title: High Martiality: With One Hand, I Single-Handedly Repel Three Thousand Emperors!
https://comix.to/title/xqg6j-high-martia.description:
A world where martial arts have revived is overrun by beasts and invading races competing against humanity. Su Hong awakens a powerful system that grants him unmatched talent and allows him to master martial arts at incredible speed. He gains Martial Dao Points by defeating enemies, which he can use to increase his strength, enhance his body, and advance through martial realms.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/26852/)

https://comix.to/title/zgk6j-unbeknownst.title: Unbeknownst to Me, I Am Secretly Dating the Emperor
https://comix.to/title/zgk6j-unbeknownst.description:
I was reincarnated in a romance fantasy where the war-crazy tyrant emperor falls in love with the saintly heroine. 

“The Emperor contracting a romantic relationship with the heroine and then falling in love is something only high society would gossip about.” 

For a minor official in the imperial palace who couldn’t even become an extra, whether I have to work overtime tomorrow is more important. Still, living diligently like a good citizen seemed to reward me with a handsome boyfriend… 

“Are you planning to hold hands throughout the entire relationship and only kiss at the wedding?” 

“You’ll regret it.” 

“I won’t.” 

Can’t I just take back what I said? 

For an extra, he was way too handsome. 

“Rina, are you planning to seduce the Emperor and run away?”

https://comix.to/title/m12d-classmate.title: Classmate
https://comix.to/title/m12d-classmate.description:
"I'll be your friend." 

A chilling ghost boy, Haesu Lee, visits the outcast, Eunha Joo. The moment she accepts this dangerous friendship, unexpected events unfold around Eunha... 

Will this hand offered by her mysterious friend be salvation, or a curse?

https://comix.to/title/1vj2d-dawn-of-ven.title: Dawn of Vengeance
https://comix.to/title/1vj2d-dawn-of-ven.description:
Arsinoe knows a few things about redos. Her first three lives all followed the same tragic script: born the scorned daughter of an enslaved queen, married to a crown prince as charming as he is cruel, and driven to death by the very man she trusted. But in her fourth, Arsinoe refuses to play the doomed princess. Determined to claim her own destiny, she forms an unexpected alliance with Walter Heibergh, the kingdom’s most formidable commander — one powerful enough to change fate itself. (From Tapas)

**Original Novel:**

https://comix.to/title/vw2lq-i-only-need.description:
"If I could go back to the past, I wouldn't love him."

After her regression, her second marriage to her ex-husband was solely for the sake of the child. Unlike her previous life, where she craved love, she chose to marry him in this second life, which she obtained like a miracle, driven by the single-minded determination to reunite with her child.

"Please keep us married for just one year."

The price was that she would cooperate with him to uncover the secrets of the incident from ten years ago, just as he wanted. She thought they were a couple in name only, bound by a contract...

"It is not absolutely necessary to consummate the marriage on the first night—"

He was different from her previous life.

https://comix.to/title/55kym-why-the-vil.title: Why the Villainess Wields the Sword
https://comix.to/title/55kym-why-the-vil.description:
No one knows how the pampered and wicked Erin Lisus suddenly becomes a top swordsman at Atenz Academy. 
That's because they don't realize that Erin was actually transported to the past after being killed by her stepmother and was reborn into different worlds. 
Now, with her past experience as a swordmaster, Erin's out to get revenge and rescue her allies from her stepmother's grasp. 

But with foes at every corner, can Erin save her loved ones? Or will her reason to wield the sword vanish with them?

https://comix.to/title/3r7n0-reincarnate.title: Reincarnated Streamer
https://comix.to/title/3r7n0-reincarnate.description: Narukami Subaru—known across the Tower as the Strongest Player and the Lord of Thunder—was betrayed and murdered by the one person he trusted most. After spending the last of his strength to save his comrades, he died… only to awaken twenty years in the future, fully aware that his death had already happened. The truth of his betrayal has long been buried. And the traitor, Kyojo Itsuki, now stands at the top as the unrivaled Number One. To take revenge—and to reach the comrades who might still be waiting for him—Subaru has to climb back to the top at breakneck speed.“The old way won’t cut it anymore.” Given a second chance, the strongest player makes an unexpected choice: He becomes a livestreamer. It doesn’t matter that the scene is overflowing with wannabes trying to copy the legend known as Narukami Subaru.“Because I’m the real thing.”

https://comix.to/title/vy36n-the-tyrants.title: The Tyrant's Overprotective Contract Mother
https://comix.to/title/vy36n-the-tyrants.description: I opened my eyes and found myself in the body of a mob bride, a nameless side character doomed to die on her wedding night at the hands of the Empire’s ruthless tyrant, Emperor Nathan. To avoid that tragic fate, I decided to stay out of trouble and live quietly as a background extra. But for some reason, Nathan suddenly took an interest in me, and before I knew it, we were married! I thought it was all over for me... until I discovered the Emperor’s biggest secret, one that guaranteed my safety instead of my death. Now that I’m safe, I can finally do what I truly love: shower my adorable stepdaughter (and absolute favorite character) with all the love she deserves! That was the plan. Except… somehow, it’s the so-called tyrant who’s spoiling me instead?! A heart-fluttering fantasy about family, fandom, and unexpected love begins!

https://comix.to/title/0vel-the-baby-fai.title: The Baby Fairy is a Villain
https://comix.to/title/0vel-the-baby-fai.description: The daughter of a mad fairy, known for her cruel nature, transforms into a baby to infiltrate a noble family and uncover those who experimented on her mother. However, the eccentric men of the family grow overly attached to her, complicating her plans. As she struggles to escape, she discovers she can’t return to her adult form, and her enemies close in.

https://comix.to/title/20lvd-endless-yea.description: Chae Do-young has admired Seo Ki-hyeon on TV ever since childhood. *“Don’t you wild beasts come talking to me.”*

Yuntae, a dominant alpha and black leopard hybridwho looks like he stepped out of a TV drama, and heir to a chaebol, transfers to the sleepy rural town where Jeongseo lives to go looking for his “first love.” Jeongseo is a terrifying least weasel hybrid. *“Jeongseo, be my friend.”  
“No. I don’t make friends with jerks.”*

For some reason, Yuntae keeps pestering Jeongseo. And then, what do you know? The first love Yuntae has been searching for all this time… it might just be Jeongseo.

*“If you find your first love, what will you do?”

I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of a certain modern fantasy I loved so much.

https://comix.to/title/l78rz-marchioness.description:
Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die.

https://comix.to/title/2l25-moral-less-s.description: Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family.

He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society.

“The only person you can trust is yourself.”

In a world ruled by the law of the strong, survival requires only two things: money and power.

While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire’s greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild.

This is the fierce struggle of Johann, who refuses to become just another prey of this brutal era.

https://comix.to/title/10kee-a-space-mar.title: A Space Marine Gets a Status Window
https://comix.to/title/10kee-a-space-mar.description:
In the year 2126, humanity has mastered gate technology to colonize space—and wage relentless war against alien monsters across the galaxy. Space Marine Kim Seo-jun thought he had already served his time, but a forced re-enlistment drags him right back to the front lines. Except this time, on the very first day of his second term, an impossible pop-up appears before his eyes: [Status Window Activated.] Armed with game-like system mechanics in a sci-fi battlefield, Seo-jun is about to show the universe what a veteran marine can truly do when the system has his back.

https://comix.to/title/30n0n-the-heroine.description:
I reincarnated as Iriya Satoshi, a mob character in a gal game world. But for some reason, the heroines are worshipping me?!
And to make matter worse, every single one of them is a complete yandere...

"I'm sorry. Please don't throw me away. Don't hate me."
"...I only have eyes for you. We'll be together forever, right?"

The actual protagonist is right there, so why are they all coming after me?!

By the way... where did my [Diary] go?

https://comix.to/title/kxm56-the-genius-.title: The Genius Professor Wants an Easy Life
https://comix.to/title/kxm56-the-genius-.description:
Born dirt-poor, the protagonist struggled through a harsh life until he eventually became the “King of Subordinates” and a legendary salesman. His ultimate goal was to become financially independent and retire early, but while playing a client company’s game for work, he somehow ended up getting transported into the game itself. And of all people, he possessed Van Ecclesia—an infamously useless, incompetent troublemaker! But wait… this might actually be perfect! He’s handsome, high-ranking, filthy rich, and completely talentless. That means he can just spend the rest of his life relaxing and living off his wealth! Except… “You have awakened the trait: Grandmaster of Magic!” “You have awakened the trait: Boundless Versatility!” “You have awakened the charisma of the Black Flame Dragon…” Ah, I said I don’t need any abilities!!

https://comix.to/title/d12k3-i-paid-the-.title: I Paid the Price and Changed the Future
https://comix.to/title/d12k3-i-paid-the-.description:
“Are you prepared to pay a price heavier than your very life?”

After losing her fiancé, Cedric, in a tragic accident, Clarice Violette visits a fortune-telling house said to grant any wish in exchange for a “price.”

When she awakens, she finds herself in a world exactly one year before Cedric’s death!?

Her joy at being reunited with her beloved Cedric is short-lived, however, when she discovers that every trace of Clarice has vanished from his memories.

“Even so! I can’t give up on him…! I’ll do anything within my power…! So please…!”

Armed with her knowledge of the future, a newly awakened “ability,” and the help of Noah, Cedric’s closest friend, Clarice sets out to uncover the truth.

What will the second chance at life she purchased at such a heavy price bring her?

And will Clarice be able to prevent Cedric’s death this time…?

A gripping tale of fate, romance, and suspense—where Clarice must uncover the truth and seize her one true love before destiny catches up with her again!

https://comix.to/title/77rle-karetsu-na-.title: Karetsu na Seijo-sama
https://comix.to/title/77rle-karetsu-na-.description:
The Kingdom of Lestwick is in the biggest predicament since its founding due to an abnormal outbreak of magical beasts that has lasted for two years, and they decide to summon a saint. And whoever appears is a gorgeous yet fierce girl dressed in foreign clothing! 

*"This is kidnapping, and you are all criminals!!"*

The saint Kana uses her fierce powers to fight back against the people from another world who rudely call her out. And so begins the merciless drama of condemnation!

https://comix.to/title/d129g-how-to-surv.title: How to Survive the Horror Novel I Wrote
https://comix.to/title/d129g-how-to-surv.description: By day, Ji-an Ha is an unassuming high school teacher-but by night, she's South Korea's top horror novelist writing runaway bestsellers of the Endless Night series. But behind her tough-sounding pen name, Ed Scar, Ji-an is actually a coward who is constantly scared by everything. Her worst fears come true when a used keyboard that she orders online somehow brings everything she writes to life, including her own original character Hades, an unhinged serial killer who ruthlessly hunts down criminals. Ji-an's only hope for survival is to make Hades love her. Can Ji-an escape her own horror novel before Hades kills her―or before she falls in love with him for real?

https://comix.to/title/nzmye-chronicles-.title: Chronicles of the Demon-Slaying Cultivator
https://comix.to/title/nzmye-chronicles-.description:
After cruelly executing the wicked ghosts that killed his parents, a young boy named Lee-se is branded as a monster by his village. Having lost all attachment to life, Lee-se meets Mong-ryeon, a goblin and ghost hunter, and adopts a new goal: to exterminate all ghosts from the world. As they begin living together, Mong-ryeon discovers a unique trait in Lee-se and sends him to 'Daemudo,' a cultivation sect known as the executioners of the cultivation world.

https://comix.to/title/602w8-clockwork-l.description:
Three years after the revolution brought down the royal dynasty, Princess Rien, who had been imprisoned underground, is forced into a political marriage with Lysian, the Duke of Roche Noir, by order of the Emperor of the Empire.

Whenever the stigma imposed by others turns against her, Rien retreats into the abyss she created within herself. Yet, through the love and solidarity she finds with him, she comes face-to-face with her true self and finally realizes the truth:

Promises and trust are stronger than fate, and they were each other’s most brilliant return—two souls who had walked beneath the same stars all along.

Use his ultimate skill to exact revenge on those hated bullies!!

https://comix.to/title/80rmn-i-accidenta.title: I Accidentally Resurrected My Dead Husband
https://comix.to/title/80rmn-i-accidenta.description:
I possessed a character in a 19+ romance novel. And I was in the body of Judith Harrington, who was forced into marriage after being sold off to pay off gambling debts.

My husband died on our wedding day, and the family is left in debt.  

…Well, it was okay. The mansion I inherited is rumored to be cursed and can’t be sold.  

…I could understand that.

‘I’m not the kind of person who would be frightened by this; I’m the kind of person who’s been through a dogfight and a possession.’ 

I vowed to make a business and live my life in the South this time. But… It’s not fair that my husband’s body doesn’t rot!

“What have you done to me?”

My husband’s dark green eyes swept over my naked body. An incomprehensible voice broke the frozen silence.

“I can’t believe we were doing that.”

My husband had come back to life.  

A character in a 19+ novel and a very naughty misunderstanding.

A world forever changed by the "Great Cataclysm."
Seo Jio, a former art teacher, dies in a sudden fire, only to be pulled into a portrait and become part of the painting itself.

https://comix.to/title/yvkww-a-wicked-hu.title: A Wicked Husband
https://comix.to/title/yvkww-a-wicked-hu.description:
When Archduke Cesare returns from war, Eileen barely recognizes the man she once knew — he's cold, commanding, and burning with unspoken desire. But nothing shakes her more than his sudden proposal. 

As old feelings stir, Eileen must choose: take his hand, or flee before his fire consumes her.

https://comix.to/title/525g-surviving-as.title: Surviving as the Illegitimate Princess
https://comix.to/title/525g-surviving-as.description:
"Don't look down on me just because I'm a child! Even though I look like this, this is my 10th life!"

I'm an illegitimate princess whose life was cut short after being misunderstood for having the same blood as the enemy country and died early. After nine tragic repetitions, I discovered the identity of my biological father. He is Paeon, a war hero who defeated the demon king and the strongest holy knight in the continent. He had a forbidden relationship with the princess, had me, and then deserted me!

In order to survive the harsh royal palace, I've decided to use and then abandon this impudent father. I will become the strongest as fast as I can and escape from this disgusting country!

And so, while I was building my strength, I happened to meet the demon king's son, Leo. He wasn't arrogant like his father, but he was pitifully living in captivity. So, I took care of him in secret.

"Asha, you cannot get engaged to anyone."

"...Huh? Why?"

"Because I’ll take responsibility for you forever."

"What?!"

"We spent the night together."

...What is this prince saying?

A holy knight father who had (?) a forbidden love. Along with an enemy prince who is trying (!) to have a forbidden love. With them, can the unfortunate princess change her fate?

---
As an illegitimate princess, Anastasia Entimos has died in just about every way imaginable. Every time she dies, she is brought back to the moment of her birth and forced to relive her tragic fate. It is only in her 10th life that she discovers her father is the esteemed knight and war hero, Paeon Parschel! Determined to escape her miserable fate once and for all, Anastasia vows to use her aloof father as a stepping stone to freedom. Will the 10th time be the charm for this ill-fated princess?

Kang Sihwa was everyone's sun, always in the spotlight, and the people around Lee Eunseo were always jealous of her because of her special childhood friend Sihwa. https://comix.to/title/2w22-cause-calyps.description: At age 3, Calypso Aquasiadel is the most outstanding genius her family's ever seen, and no wonder... She's actually a modern girl who's been reborn into the same novel thrice! This time around, Calypso's determined to harness the powers of the mysterious dragon duke and send herself back home. The only problem is, she'll first need to earn the respect of her hardened family to survive until then! Can Calypso win their approval and even their hearts? Or is this life doomed for another do-over?

https://comix.to/title/grg7k-hell-mode.title: Hell Mode
https://comix.to/title/grg7k-hell-mode.description:
Yamada Kenichi, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a "Hell Mode" — a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential.

Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him. Allen works diligently to level himself up despite Hell Mode requiring vast amounts of experience between levels. In doing so, he hopes to uncover the secrets the Summoner class holds. All the while, he dedicates himself to freeing his new family from serfdom.

https://comix.to/title/djd8-the-incognit.title: The Incognito Princess
https://comix.to/title/djd8-the-incognit.description:
When a woman dies prematurely, a goddess allows her to choose a new world to reincarnate into. Without hesitation, she picks the web novel Infinite Splash—home to her beloved favorite character, Kylo Grey. In a stroke of irony, she becomes the stunningly beautiful but utterly evil Princess Agnes Saint, who obsesses over the male lead, Raymond Spencer, and detests Kylo for being a commoner.

In the original story, Kylo's bitter rivalry with Raymond and deep insecurities made him Agnes' sworn enemy. Yet fans ultimately wept at his death, as his sacrifice was devastatingly selfless. The new Agnes, however, could not care less about the established plot. All she wants is a front-row seat to Kylo's life and to prevent his senseless death. But to live her fangirl dreams, she must drop her fixation on Raymond, convince everyone that she has changed, and somehow earn Kylo's trust.

https://comix.to/title/2veyn-lout-of-cou.title: Lout of Count's Family
https://comix.to/title/2veyn-lout-of-cou.description:
Kim Roksu has one life motto: “Let’s not get beat up.”

But after dozing off somewhere midway through the novel “Birth of a Hero,” he wakes up as Cale Henituse - one of the minor villains in the novel who gets the beating of a lifetime from soon-to-be hero Choi Han.

Only time will tell how much longer he has before that dreadful encounter. Can Kim Roksu change the course of this story so he can enjoy a long and lavish life free of the soon-to-be hero?

https://comix.to/title/emrmx-lookism.title: Lookism
https://comix.to/title/emrmx-lookism.description:
Park Hyung-Seok is an unattractive loner who wakes up in a different body. Now tall, handsome, and cooler than ever in his new form, Hyung-Seok aims to achieve everything he couldn't before.

How far will he go to keep his body... and his secrets?

https://comix.to/title/dg18-a-toddlers-g.title: A Toddler's Guide to Gentle Parenting a Villain
https://comix.to/title/dg18-a-toddlers-g.description:
Lablaine had already lived her life three times, and was now living it *again*. Due to a misinterpretation of an oracle, she had been raised as a "Child of Fate" and was asked to choose a guardian. During the first time she lived her life, she lived in a strict knight's household, but when the real "Child of Fate" appeared, she was sacrificed as a scapegoat for them. During the second time, she was abused by an outwardly respectable scholar; the third time, she ran away and lived as a beggar. Since the country seems to not be safe for her, she decided to leave it this time. To that end she chose… a family of the biggest and coldest villains in the kingdom. She just tried to get along with them for the time being, but her family has turned out to be absurdly overprotective and doting?!  
  
Promo for the novel.

https://comix.to/title/5v6mk-second-life.title: Second Life Ranker
https://comix.to/title/5v6mk-second-life.description:
Yeonwoo’s brother disappeared years ago, and he’s devastated to learn of his death.

As he copes with his loss, he’s given a pocket watch and learns there’s more to his brother’s death: he was betrayed while competing in the Tower of the Sun God.

Now it’s Yeonwoo’s turn to use the knowledge his brother left behind.

Can Yeonwoo navigate that world and gain enough power and experience to reach the top of the tower, defeating his brother’s enemies and all those who stand in his way?

https://comix.to/title/x36j-waka-chan-wa.description: Tomoya is a college freshman on a mission to finally get his first ever girlfriend, but with one small problem: he's still a virgin! https://comix.to/title/6xlz-an-insincere.title: An Insincere Idol's Blank Slate
https://comix.to/title/6xlz-an-insincere.description:
‘I want to do real music now instead of these fucking idol songs.’

Yoon Eden, an idol in his 8th year, was tired of working with his shitty agency so he worked on the side as a composer.
He succeeded in music composition and bought a house in Cheongdam-dong, but has become an arrogant celebrity.

[Your 30,000th fan is disappointed in you.]
[Starting a project to help idols regain their lost, original intentions!]

But what the hell? He was sent to his debut days when his group was at its lowest to find his original intentions-

[The conditions have been met.]
[You have disappointed 30 thousand fans, now make 30 million fans happy!]

There’s even a mission that's only possible to complete for 1st tier idols?!

“Fuck, my Cheongdam-dong house! My billion-dollar royalties! My Ferrari!”

[Profanity detected.] [Original Intent -2]

[When Original Intent falls to 0, you start over again!]

Even in these harsh conditions that threaten infinite regression, will the project help this idol find his lost, original intentions?

https://comix.to/title/e32r-top-rankers-.description:
A legendary hunter gives up his title to become a web novelist, only to realize his stories lack realism. To fix this, he disguises himself as a weak F-rank hunter and joins a struggling guild for research. What starts as simple observation turns into genuine admiration, pushing him to grow both as a person and a writer. Can a former god-like warrior succeed as an ordinary novelist?

https://comix.to/title/nldxn-involuntary.title: Involuntary Romance
https://comix.to/title/nldxn-involuntary.description:
Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

https://comix.to/title/e5le-hero-killer.description:
The world is in constant turmoil, with constant wars breaking out between Heroes and Villains.

Gifted with supernatural abilities, one lone girl sets out on a bloody path for revenge against the injustices of the world she lives in. With the constant clashes between titans, no one is safe.

If no one is willing to protect the innocent, who are the real heroes, and who are the real villains? What truly separates one from the other?

https://comix.to/title/5v53l-mairimashit.description:
Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki has the worst luck possible! Incapable of saying no to anyone, he has always performed whatever life-threatening jobs his greedy and lazy parents requested. His life takes an unexpected turn when they form a contract with Sullivan, a high-ranking demon, at the cost of his soul. Afraid and confused, Iruma is surprised that all Sullivan wants is to act as his grandfather.

Sullivan takes care of Iruma and decides to enroll him in the demon school Babyls. Iruma's greatest challenge is hiding his status as a human, so keeping a low profile among his peers is the only option. However, Iruma will soon discover that he is no ordinary human, and the demons might also be more than what meets the eye.

https://comix.to/title/e1ylr-i-regressed.title: I Regressed, So I'm Entering a Fake Engagement with My Favorite Grand Duke
https://comix.to/title/e1ylr-i-regressed.description: A real-life Cinderella uses her past life's "fan activities" as a weapon to change her fate —!? After her mother's death, Ella, a count's daughter, was oppressed by her stepmother and stepsisters, living like a servant. As soon as she came of age, she was forced to marry a gambling-addicted viscount. The only support in her desperate days was her "fan activities" for the nation's hero — Grand Duke Wellington. Ella was so obsessed with the Grand Duke that she memorized every piece of information about him. But one day, she was sold off by her husband-in-name-only to pay off his debts. At the end of her despair, Ella lost consciousness — and when she woke up, she was in the past, at age 18. Vowing never to repeat the same tragedy, Ella proposes a fake engagement to the Grand Duke Wellington — the man she admires — in order to protect her mother's inheritance. What future will Ella's bold choice lead her to —?

https://comix.to/title/9lqy6-otherworld-.title: Otherworld General Store
https://comix.to/title/9lqy6-otherworld-.description:
Han Ji-oh, the owner of an all-purpose neighborhood store, discovers a dimensional portal opened by a kitchen knife. 
Through it, he begins traveling back and forth between the real world and another world. 
Using a subspace, he starts doing business in both worlds, selling goods and making money. 
His modest dream was simply to earn enough to become a building owner and live comfortably. 
But then he gets dragged into a hero’s party and is told to stop the Demon King from being resurrected?! Thus begins Han Ji-oh’s dimension-hopping commercial action fantasy, as the owner of the Otherworldly General Store!

https://comix.to/title/00eld-sumisaka-sa.title: Sumisaka-san's Wild Delusions!
https://comix.to/title/00eld-sumisaka-sa.description: Sumisaka and Tsukishiro are so innocent that they're still just novice couples who only walk home together. They're such a pure couple that everyone around them is amazed. However, Sumisaka's mind is... full of rather naughty fantasies! But even under such cruel environments, survivors lived on with hope, and swore to take back Earth to rebuild civilization. This manhua records the stories of people in such a world, who influenced the course of history with their own hands.
